mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical fourteen-period stochastic %K crossing its three-period %D inside an overbought or oversold completed four-hour range marks exhaustion resolving away from the range edge; follow the crossover direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when %K crosses strictly above %D while %K<=20; short when %K crosses strictly below %D while %K>=80
mechanism.why_distinct: RSI uses recursively smoothed close changes, Aroon uses extrema timestamps, and Donchian uses boundary breaks. HVSTOCH locates the completed close inside a rolling high-low range and requires a fixed three-period signal-line crossover at canonical extremes, with no RSI/Aroon state, OI, flow, volume, funding, fitted outcome, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour range-location crossover clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.percent_k: 100*(current close-lowest low over latest 14 completed bars)/(highest high-lowest low), invalid at zero range
features.percent_d: simple mean of latest three finite %K values
features.crossover: strict current %K-%D sign change from immediately prior finite nonzero difference, with current %K at the matching 20/80 extreme
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical range-location extreme crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no stochastic period, signal smoothing, 20/80 level, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: George Lane, canonical stochastic oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 14 completed periods for %K, three-period simple %D, conventional 20/80 extremes, crossover direction
external_basis.selection_use: standard published periods, levels, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
